name: 早熟青黄皮小果蜜橘款
description: 早熟小果蜜橘奶油粉彩瓷盘日光套图：皮薄易剥、细嫩多汁，转色期青皮正常说明

styleLock.direction: bright airy pastel citrus table commerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: creamy white #FFF9F2 studio backdrop for photo-led screens, oat-apricot #FBE8CF soft panels for opening and closing screens; scalloped wave dividers between sections; capsule and circular photo masks for gallery panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key morning daylight, soft front-left window key with white bounce fill, 5000-5500K, airy gentle shadows, soft contact shadow, dewy fruit highlights, no harsh speculars and no plastic look
styleLock.surfaceSystem: blush-pink glazed ceramic plate, striped cotton-linen cloth, matte white countertop, natural orchard foliage for tree shots
styleLock.typography: rounded friendly sans-serif headlines in cocoa #4A3222; no serif, no brush calligraphy, no handwritten display faces; oat-apricot #FBE8CF reserved for soft background panels
styleLock.iconSystem: small solid heart doodles and soft rounded pill labels in one apricot #F08A24 accent; capsule and circular photo masks; no outlined ring ornaments
styleLock.presentationRules: fruit shown in three consistent states (whole with fresh green leaf, halved, peeled segments) on the porcelain plate with a soft contact shadow; stable scale across the set; fresh green leaves as recurring garnish
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright airy pastel citrus table visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of creamy white #FFF9F2, blush porcelain pink #F6D7D2, oat-apricot #FBE8CF, apricot-orange accent #F08A24 and cocoa-brown text #4A3222; warm tone throughout; bright high-key morning daylight with a soft front-left key, gentle airy shadows and soft contact shadows, dewy but never plastic fruit; rounded friendly sans-serif headlines in cocoa; scalloped wave section dividers with small solid heart doodles and soft rounded pill labels in #F08A24; capsule and circular photo masks for gallery panels; fruit presented in consistent whole-with-leaf, halved and peeled-segment states on a blush-pink glazed ceramic plate with stable scale; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no dark moody wood styling, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit texture.

provenance.notes: 从 8 屏爆款蜜橘详情长图提炼。已剥离全部产地地名、纬度卖点、仓储仓库名、会员二维码贴纸、店铺标识与全部原文案；规格/重量/日期/甜酸比等原数值一律改为 {callout_n} 文案槽，由使用方按实际信息填写，未编造糖度、检测、认证与销量。产品一律以 {product} 占位；视觉语法保留为明亮粉彩瓷盘日光系。
